🖼Armenian translation of "Cell No. 14: The Autobiography of Ayatollah Khamenei" unveiled in Yerevan

🔹The Armenian translation of the book "Cell No. 14: The Autobiography of Ayatollah Khamenei," the autobiographical memoir of the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Martyr Ayatollah Sayyid Ali Khamenei (may God elevate his noble station), was unveiled at Yerevan State University.

🔹The ceremony took place on Friday, Oct. 9, 2026, at 3 p.m. local time at the Faculty of Oriental Studies of Yerevan State University.

🔹The translation was carried out by Maryam Zazian, an Iranologist and translator.

🔹The event was organized by the Cultural Chancellery of the Embassy of the Islamic Republic of Iran in Armenia and the Islamic Revolution Institute, in cooperation with the Faculty of Oriental Studies at Yerevan State University.

🔹Speakers at the ceremony include Ahmad Donyamali, Iran's Minister of Sports and Youth; Mohammad Akhgari, Deputy for International Affairs at the Islamic Revolution Institute; Khalil Shirgholami, Ambassador of the Islamic Republic of Iran to Armenia; and Vartan Voskanyan, Head of the Iranian Studies Department at Yerevan State University.

🔹The book recounts Ayatollah Sayyid Ali Khamenei's memoirs from his years of struggle and imprisonment before the victory of the Islamic Revolution in Iran.

🔹It was first published in Arabic under the title "Indeed, with Patience Comes Victory" and was later published in Persian as "The Heart's Blood That Turned to Ruby."
